start.speaker: abeni
start.text: Hold! Hands where we see them. Concord, or crew? Either way, you're standing in our dead's house.

choices.text: Ember-tide. Senna sent me. She's alive, in cold storage.
(Show the kinship token.) I'm owed a hearing.
The WARDEN is killing everyone aboard, us and you. We're not your enemy. Let us pass to command.
You're three. We're armed, and we've had a very bad day. Walk away.

effects.reason: Pushed the reclaimers' minds with Resonance

choices.text: Then we do this the hard way.

pass.speaker: abeni
pass.text: Ember-tide... Senna's alive? Rusk, Dov, lower them. You saved a lantern-keeper. The hall owes you a light. Go on to your command chamber. We will not touch you.

pass_dead.speaker: abeni
pass_dead.text: Where did you get that word? Where is Senna? ...You don't answer. Rusk, Dov — they've got her word and not her. Weapons up!

token.speaker: abeni
token.text: A kinship glyph. Haldis-born. All right, kin. You get your hearing. Talk fast.

choices.text: We're getting passengers off this ship. That's all. The hold is your business, not ours.
Let us through and I'll speak for your dead at command.

talked.speaker: abeni
talked.text: ...Fine. Go. If you're lying, the Marshal will be in Bay 2 to explain our position more thoroughly.

swayed.speaker: narrator
swayed.text: You reach into the space behind their eyes and press. Rusk's rifle dips first. Then Abeni's. They step aside without quite knowing why.

withdraw.speaker: abeni
withdraw.text: ...Pull back. Back to the breach. We'll take this to the Marshal.

fled.speaker: system
fled.text: The reclaimers withdraw toward the dorsal breach. You'll likely see them again.
